Split a PDF into separate files

Save every page as its own PDF, cut the document into page ranges, or pull out just the pages you select. Several files download together as a ZIP.

How to split a PDF

  1. Choose the PDF you want to split.
  2. Pick a method: every page, page ranges, or selected pages.
  3. Select Split and download.

How your files are handled

Your files are opened, changed and saved by this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, and the original file on your device is never modified. Closing the tab discards everything, so download your result first.

Questions

Are my files uploaded?
No. Everything runs in your browser with PDF.js and pdf-lib. Your documents are never sent to a server.
How do I write page ranges?
Separate ranges with commas. For example, 1-3, 4, 5-10 makes three files: pages 1 to 3, page 4, and pages 5 to 10.
Why did I get a ZIP file?
When a split produces more than one PDF, the files are packed into one ZIP so your browser downloads them together.
Is it free?
Yes. There is no account, no watermark, no daily limit and no paid tier.
